title: Comunicado 2025-03-27
summary: Banxico cut the policy rate by another 50bp to 9.00% and repeated that it could keep calibrating the stance and consider adjusting it by a similar magnitude, i.e. an explicit signal of further sizeable cuts, while keeping the stance restrictive. The case rests on continued disinflation (headline and core around their pre-pandemic averages), an inflation risk balance that, though still tilted up, has improved, and an economy expected to show weakness again in Q1 with important downside risks from trade tensions. Versus the 6 February communique, the guidance is unchanged but the decision is now unanimous: the lone dissenter who wanted a smaller cut joined the 50bp move, so the Board speaks with one voice for the faster easing pace, a more dovish message than in February. US tariffs are flagged as adding two-sided uncertainty rather than as a reason to slow down.

key_quotes.quote: la Junta de Gobierno con la presencia de todos sus miembros, decidió por unanimidad reducir en 50 puntos base el objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día a un nivel de 9.00%.
La Junta de Gobierno estima que hacia delante podría continuar con la calibración de la postura monetaria y considerar ajustarla en magnitud similar.
key_quotes.context: Explicit guidance for further cuts of similar (50bp) size

key_quotes.quote: Se considera que el balance de riesgos respecto de la trayectoria prevista para la inflación en el horizonte de pronóstico si bien se mantiene sesgado al alza, ha mejorado.
key_quotes.context: Risk balance still up but improved

key_quotes.quote: Se prevé que en el primer trimestre de 2025 la actividad económica nacional nuevamente exhiba debilidad.
